solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Discordant cheering going round West London borough

indicators.note: the rearranged letters circle the abbreviation, holding it inside
discordant sounds are jumbled and out of harmony, so the letters of the next word are rearranged

explanation.surface: Jarring cheers echoing around a district of west London.
explanation.walkthrough: 'West' looks part of the definition, but it only supplies W, which goes inside GREENICH (the anagram of CHEERING from 'Discordant'); Greenwich is actually in south-east London.
explanation.definitionFit: Greenwich is one of the boroughs into which Greater London is divided, home of the Royal Observatory.

clue.text: Plant fish on top of no end of parasites

parts.note: the gar is a long-snouted freshwater fish

indicators.note: the word for the parasites loses its final letter

parts.note: lice are small parasitic insects

explanation.surface: An instruction to put a fish on top of an infestation of parasites.
explanation.definitionFit: Garlic is a bulbous plant of the onion family grown for its pungent cloves.

clue.text: Replace old money

parts.note: ex- as a prefix means former or old
change is money in coins, or money handed back

explanation.surface: Swap out obsolete currency for new.
explanation.definitionFit: To exchange something is to give it up and take another in its place, i.e. to swap it.

clue.text: In China use aspirin with feeling of revulsion

indicators.note: the letters sought lie in the run of words that follows, spanning their boundaries

explanation.surface: In China people take aspirin when they feel sick.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In' signals the letters sit within 'chiNA USE Aspirin'.
explanation.definitionFit: Nausea is sickness or disgust, the queasy feeling of strong revulsion.

clue.text: Completely fashionable round, small drink included

indicators.note: the small drink is placed within the fashionable-round combination

parts.note: in means fashionable, as in 'the in thing'
a round shape resembles the letter O
a tot is a small measure of spirits

explanation.surface: A fashionable round of drinks with a little tot thrown in.
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin phrase means as a whole, entirely, without exception.

clue.text: Rustic having taken a turn in one's house first

indicators.note: the possessive comes ahead of the other piece in the answer

parts.note: home's is the possessive of home, one's house
spun means rotated, taken a turn

explanation.surface: A country type who has had a spin round their own house first.
explanation.definitionFit: Homespun means plain and unsophisticated, simple in a rustic, homemade way.

clue.text: Cover monkey that's half grey first

indicators.note: the half-colour comes before the animal
only the first two of the four letters of the colour word are kept

parts.note: drab is a dull greyish-brown colour
ape is a general word for a monkey

explanation.surface: Throw a cover over a greyish monkey.
explanation.walkthrough: Drab is a dull brownish-grey shade, so 'grey' stands for it before 'half' trims it.
explanation.definitionFit: To drape something is to cover it loosely with cloth; a drape is also a covering curtain.

clue.text: Duke had mature spirits from equatorial region

parts.note: old means mature, advanced in years
rums are spirits distilled from sugar cane

explanation.surface: A duke drinking aged spirits brought from the tropics.
explanation.definitionFit: The doldrums are the belt of calm winds near the equator where sailing ships were becalmed.

clue.text: A church has articles on mysteries

parts.note: RC stands for Roman Catholic, a church
ana is a collection of anecdotes or articles about a person

explanation.surface: A church publishes articles on religious mysteries.
explanation.definitionFit: Arcana are secrets or mysteries known only to the initiated; plural of arcanum.

clue.text: How agreement may be made across the bridge?

definitions.text: How agreement may be made across the bridge?

parts.words: How agreement may be made across the bridge?
parts.note: seeing things the same way, with gazes meeting across the bridge of the nose

explanation.surface: A question about how two sides reach a deal over a bridge, perhaps a card game or a river.
explanation.walkthrough: The bridge is that of the nose, with an organ of sight on each side.
explanation.definitionFit: To see things in the same way as someone is to be in full accord with them.

clue.text: Tell fidgety neurotic one is missing

indicators.note: fidgety letters cannot keep still, so they are rearranged
says that a letter is dropped from the jumbled fodder

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Telling a restless, nervous person that something is missing.
explanation.walkthrough: NEUROTIC without its I is rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: To tell, in the old sense, is to count; to recount is to narrate or relate.

clue.text: Consequence of losing one's balance

parts.note: the balance is that in a bank account, not physical steadiness

explanation.surface: What happens when someone stumbles and falls.
explanation.definitionFit: Spending past a positive bank balance leaves the account in debit to the bank.

clue.text: Not much money once VAT has been removed

indicators.note: read as re-moved: the letters have been moved again into a new order

explanation.surface: Little cash is left after value added tax is taken off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'removed' suggests deletion but is read as re-moved, rearranging ONCE and VAT. VAT is the British sales tax.
explanation.definitionFit: A centavo is a small coin, a hundredth of the peso or real in several countries.

clue.text: Down mature fruit first

indicators.note: the fruit comes before the other piece in the answer

parts.note: a plum is a fruit
to age is to mature

explanation.surface: Plunge into ripe fruit before anything else.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Down' is the soft fluffy feathers of a bird, not a direction.
explanation.definitionFit: Plumage is a bird's feathering; down is its fine soft feathers.

clue.text: He dominates a foe becoming too progressive

indicators.note: the letters of the phrase turn into something new, a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: A man overpowers his enemy and grows too forward-thinking.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone with ideas too modern for the era they live in is described this way.

clue.text: Recommend one pressing a suit

definitions.meaning: to argue publicly in favour of something
a lawyer pushing a lawsuit in court, not someone ironing clothes

explanation.surface: Suggest someone to do the ironing.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means to support or urge; as a noun it is a barrister who argues a case.

clue.text: Diane gave article to left-winger who was hesitant

parts.note: Di is a short form of the name Diane
the is the definite article
a red is a communist or socialist

explanation.surface: Diane handed an article to a socialist who was unsure about it.
explanation.definitionFit: To dither is to be indecisive and dally over a choice.

clue.text: Tree reported, about time, needing emergency attention

parts.note: a fir is a coniferous tree

indicators.note: the word for reported is placed around the letter for time

parts.note: said means reported or stated

explanation.surface: A tree was said to need urgent care at some point.
explanation.definitionFit: First aid is the immediate treatment given to an injured person before full medical help arrives.

clue.text: Takes fancy diamonds originally from boot!

indicators.note: the gems come at the start, before the rearranged letters

parts.note: ice is slang for diamonds

indicators.note: fancy means elaborate or fanciful, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone helps themselves to elaborate diamonds pulled from a boot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Takes fancy' looks like a phrase meaning likes, but 'fancy' rearranges TAKES into SKATE.
explanation.definitionFit: An ice skate is a boot fitted with a blade for gliding on ice.

clue.text: One calls for item hidden in mask

indicators.note: the short word goes inside the mask word

parts.note: a visor is a face mask or shield
it refers to a thing, an item, in the sense 'the thing in question'

explanation.surface: Someone telephones looking for a thing concealed in a disguise.
explanation.definitionFit: A visitor is one who calls on you, paying a call at your home.

clue.text: Beginning well

definitions.meaning: the season of new growth, or the source of something
a natural source of water rising from the ground

explanation.definitionFit: Spring is both a starting point or the opening season and a natural water source like a well.

clue.text: With German agreement, he replaced one in path of Noachic descendant

parts.note: ja is German for yes

indicators.note: the pronoun takes the place of a letter in the next word

parts.note: A, the indefinite article, means one

explanation.surface: With a German yes, a man took someone's place on the route of Noah's lineage.
explanation.walkthrough: PATH with its A swapped for HE gives PHETH.
explanation.definitionFit: Japheth was one of the three sons of Noah in Genesis, hence descended from him.

clue.text: Yours truly in Provence right to take nearest and dearest's coat

parts.note: je is French for I, the speaker, yours truly
kin means one's family

explanation.surface: A Provençal speaker with the right to wear their family's coat.
explanation.definitionFit: A jerkin is a sleeveless jacket, an old style of close-fitting coat.

clue.text: Father takes two Spanish articles from dish

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father
el is the Spanish masculine definite article
la is the Spanish feminine definite article

explanation.surface: Dad helps himself to two Spanish things from a plate.
explanation.definitionFit: Paella is a Spanish rice dish cooked with saffron, seafood or chicken.

clue.text: Poles support own harbours

indicators.note: in a down clue the supporting letters sit underneath

parts.note: to have is to own or possess
N and S are the north and south poles

explanation.surface: Polish people back their own ports.
explanation.definitionFit: Havens are safe harbours where ships can shelter.

clue.text: Saw something for him to do

definitions.text: Saw something for him to do

parts.words: Saw something for him to do
parts.note: saw is a tool to cut with, not past tense of see

explanation.surface: Someone noticed a job needing doing for a man.
explanation.definitionFit: A woodworker saws timber as part of the daily trade.

clue.text: Be brave enough to have short skirt in front in Ireland

definitions.note: a place in Ireland; the clue gives location rather than a noun

indicators.note: the shortened garment comes ahead of the other piece
the garment word loses its last letter

parts.note: a kilt is a pleated tartan skirt
to dare is to be bold enough to do something

explanation.surface: Having the nerve to wear a miniskirt in Ireland.
explanation.definitionFit: Kildare is a county and town west of Dublin, famous for horse racing.

clue.text: Was evasive but did not start having advanced gradually

indicators.note: the word for evasive drops its opening letter

parts.note: hedged means avoided committing oneself

explanation.surface: Someone dodged the issue yet kept inching forward.
explanation.definitionFit: To edge is to move slowly and carefully, a little at a time.

clue.text: Brown grease spilt on clothing

parts.note: dun is a dull greyish-brown colour

indicators.note: spilt grease is scattered, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Brown grease spilled down someone's work clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: Dungarees are hard-wearing overalls or trousers with a bib, a work garment.
